description: This file contains functions for initializing and managing default templates in the focalboard server application, including template import logic, version checks, and board/block fixing functions.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct for focalboard server, containing methods for template management.

methods.name: initializeTemplates
methods.description: Imports default templates if the boards table is empty or contains outdated templates.

methods.name: isInitializationNeeded
methods.description: Checks if template initialization is required based on existing boards.

methods.name: fixTemplateBlock
methods.description: Adjusts a block to be included as part of a template, skipping certain blocks based on cache.

methods.name: fixTemplateBoard
methods.description: Adjusts a board to be included as part of a template, setting properties and filtering out non-template boards.
